quality.review_scope: Scoped main-text recipe and Figures 1,2,3,5,7 accepted after full independent review of main pp.1–12 and SI pp.1–17, and corrective source/asset checks. SI was read as context; this package does not extract every SI result. Presentation and delivery are pending.
missing_fields: Exact Cd and S stock aliquot volumes for each of nine SILAR shell cycles are not reported in the inspected main text; Ref.22 not independently extracted.
Main text gives quantified 10 wt% polymer composite; 5, 20 and 25 wt% comparisons lack equivalent charge details and are contextual, not extra pairs.
The 3-decyl-1-vinylimidazolium chloride monomer preparation is not described in main Methods.
No measured atomic coordinates or coherent CdSe/CdS interface model; unit cells are separate bulk references.
TEM of recovered polymerized QDs is described but data not shown in main; SI not inspected.
Shell-growth OA chemical identity, Methods/Figure 1A ligand durations and binding solvent remain unresolved source conflicts; do not train on one chosen branch.
conflicts: p.3 CdSe Cores paragraph calls estimated QDs 10 nm; p.4 Results assigns ~4 nm CdSe cores and nine CdS monolayers, while p.5 SAXS yields 10.3 nm diameter for the core-shell QDs. Preserve wording and referent ambiguity.
p.3 heading labels QD-bound imidazolium conjugate with [Cl−]; p.3 prose and Figure 1A identify bromide counterion. Counterion of surface species unresolved.

p.3 SeTOP stock is labelled 0.2 M, but 2.36 g Se in 15 mL TOP gives ~1.99 M using TOP volume as a proxy; final stock volume is unknown. Both source claims and calculation are retained; actual stock and injected Se molarity unresolved.
For the separate free 3-decyl-1-vinylimidazolium monomer, p.3 and p.4 prose name chloride while Figure 1B draws Br− for compound (4). Its counterion is independently unresolved.
p.4 gives native QD PL FWHM 29 nm; p.6 PL comparison gives native FWHM 35 nm. Both statements retained.
p.3 reports 19 mg water and calls final composition 30 ± 2 wt%; 19/(4.5+40.5+19)=29.69% calculated, compatible but do not replace reported range.

Thiol precursor Methods (main p.3) give KOH in EtOH 2 h and HCl 10% v/v stir 1 h; Figure 1A (main p.4) instead gives KOH/EtOH reflux 12 h and HCl 2 h. Both branches retained without choosing or averaging.

Thiol binding Methods (main p.3) use 5 mL ACN and 2 h standing; Figure 1A (main p.4) shows DMF at room temperature for 2 h, with no DMF amount. Both source branches retained; the operation inputs describe Methods only.

Main p.2 Materials abbreviates oleylamine 70% as OA, whereas main p.3 stock methods expand OA as oleic acid 90%. Shell-growth line says 5 mL OA without expansion; its exact shell-feed chemical identity is unresolved.
Main p.3 prints Mg2SO4 for the drying agent. The conventional MgSO4 interpretation is plausible but unverified; no source formula is silently corrected.
Main p.1 abstract reports composite PL maximum 638 nm; main p.6 comparison reports 637 nm for the 10 wt% composite. Both source values retained; the numeric measurement uses p.6 context.
